title: Generate and verify deterministic CLR binding fingerprints for four opt-in Math Discovery operations
commitMessage: feat: generate deterministic selected Math Discovery CLR binding receipt

contribution.summary: Generate a deterministic, Math-owned receipt of the four deliberately selected Discovery CLR signatures and SHA-256 fingerprints from actual assemblies.
contribution.value: Implement a bounded C# binding generator with write/check modes; verify exact static overloads against the candidate inventory, assembly versions, result types, and SHA-256 of canonical signatures. Reuse RS131 portable conformance and RS184 compiled consumer evidence without repeating either campaign.
debtChanges: RS184 succeeded attempt 001 first-pass with four compiled selected CLR method signatures and bounded IR examples; it did not qualify a broker or package-installed skill.
RS185 is the deterministic fingerprint and provenance layer required before schema-2 manifest and skill generation; it admits no public helper discovery by convention.
RS131's 13 portable protocol fixtures are historical qualified evidence and are not rerun. M8 remains not-ready and backlog 0.1.123 is preserved.
The receipt reports BrokerReady=0, skill=false and package-consumer=false. No AURA integration or existing package revision is claimed.

RS185 preselection run-next-20261112T143421Z-a18c74be22a299dc refused before attempt allocation: CS8602 on nullable MethodInfo and declaring Assembly. Replace assertion-only flow with explicit fail-fast guards; retain exact CLR checks.
contribution.nextAction: After durable success, generate a schema-2 Math manifest and hierarchical opt-in skill from the exact binding receipt, with deterministic regeneration and drift refusal.
